sentences.en: How an outlandish conspiracy theory, born on the fringes of the internet, ended up at a real-world rally for President Trump.
sentences.zh: 一个诞生于互联网边缘的离奇阴谋论，是如何最终出现在特朗普总统的现实集会上的。

sentences.en: The story of QAnon.
sentences.zh: QAnon的故事。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月2日，星期四。

sentences.en: Hello, Florida.
sentences.zh: 你好，佛罗里达。

sentences.en: Kevin, what happened at this rally on Tuesday?
sentences.zh: 凯文，周二的集会上发生了什么？

sentences.en: I am thrilled to be in this great state where we, by the way, had a great victory.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴来到这个伟大的州，顺便说一句，我们在这里取得了伟大的胜利。

sentences.en: In some ways, it was a pretty typical Trump rally.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这是一场相当典型的特朗普集会。

sentences.en: With thousands of hardworking American patriots who love our country and respect our great
sentences.zh: 有成千上万热爱我们国家、尊重我们伟大

sentences.en: American flag.
sentences.zh: 美国国旗的勤劳的美国爱国者。

sentences.en: Lots of supporters there.
sentences.zh: 那里有很多支持者。

sentences.en: You had people booing the media.
sentences.zh: 有人在向媒体喝倒彩。

sentences.en: And then you had this new element.
sentences.zh: 然后出现了这个新元素。

sentences.en: They wore shirts and signs emblazoned with only the letter Q.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着印有字母Q的衬衫，举着写有字母Q的标语。

sentences.en: The letter Q, as in the letter on the t-shirts of Trump supporters in Tampa.
sentences.zh: 字母Q，就像坦帕市特朗普支持者T恤上的那个字母一样。

sentences.en: Which was that in the crowd behind and sort of around Trump, TV cameras picked up several people wearing t-shirts and holding signs that said Q.
sentences.zh: 当时在特朗普身后和周围的人群中，电视摄像机捕捉到了几个人穿着印有Q字的T恤，举着写有Q字的标语。

sentences.en: And what does that refer to, Q?
sentences.zh: Q指的是什么？

sentences.en: Man, how much time do you have?
sentences.zh: 伙计，你有多少时间？

sentences.en: We could go on.
sentences.zh: 我们可以一直说下去。

sentences.en: I'd say usually 20 to 25 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我通常会说20到25分钟。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I'll try to condense it down.
sentences.zh: 我会尽量精简一下。

sentences.en: So Q is the central figure in a vast internet-driven conspiracy theory called QAnon.
sentences.zh: Q是一个名为QAnon的庞大互联网阴谋论的核心人物。

sentences.en: QAnon.
sentences.zh: QAnon。

sentences.en: QAnon.
sentences.zh: QAnon。

sentences.en: Q-A-N-O-N for anonymous.
sentences.zh: Q-A-N-O-N，代表匿名者。

sentences.en: This all started last October when an anonymous person posted on 4chan, the internet message
sentences.zh: 这一切始于去年10月，当时一个匿名人士在互联网留言板4chan上发帖，

sentences.en: board, calling themselves Q, which referred to Q clearance, which is sort of a high-level government security clearance.
sentences.zh: 自称为Q，这指的是Q级许可，这是一种高级别的政府安全许可。

sentences.en: And the Post sort of had a list of rhetorical questions about issues in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 帖子中列出了一系列关于美国问题的反问，

sentences.en: like, does POTUS know where the bodies are buried?
sentences.zh: 比如，总统知道尸体埋在哪里吗？

sentences.en: Does POTUS have the goods on most bad actors?
sentences.zh: 总统掌握了大多数坏人的罪证吗？

sentences.en: Was Trump asked to run for president?
sentences.zh: 特朗普是被要求竞选总统的吗？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: By who?
sentences.zh: 被谁？

sentences.en: Was HRC next in line?
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿是下一个排队的人吗？

sentences.en: Was the election supposed to be rigged?
sentences.zh: 选举本该是被操纵的吗？

sentences.en: Did good people prevent the rigging?
sentences.zh: 好人阻止了操纵吗？

sentences.en: So these questions and the other hints that Q began to drop in 4chan became known as crumbs.
sentences.zh: 所以这些问题以及Q开始在4chan上抛出的其他暗示被称为“面包屑”。

sentences.en: The intel comes directly to us, and then we disperse it.
sentences.zh: 情报直接传给我们，然后我们将其散布出去。

sentences.en: It's the only way, Q says.
sentences.zh: Q说，这是唯一的方法。

sentences.en: People united hold the power.
sentences.zh: 团结的人民掌握权力。

sentences.en: All of us.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人。

sentences.en: And people started following these and latching onto these and sort of assembling them into a giant interconnected conspiracy theory.
sentences.zh: 人们开始跟随这些暗示，抓住它们，并把它们拼凑成一个巨大的、相互关联的阴谋论。

sentences.en: And what's the plot?
sentences.zh: 那么情节是什么？

sentences.en: So the plot is a little jumbled.
sentences.zh: 情节有点混乱。

sentences.en: There are many versions of it out there.
sentences.zh: 外面有很多版本。

sentences.en: But what most
sentences.zh: 但大多数

sentences.en: QAnon believers believe is that every president before Donald Trump was part of a nefarious group, a cabal of criminals.
sentences.zh: QAnon信徒认为，唐纳德·特朗普之前的每一位总统都是一个邪恶组织、一个犯罪集团的成员。

sentences.en: Every president after Reagan was one of these deep state criminals, and their empire got even stronger.
sentences.zh: 里根之后的每一位总统都是这些深层政府罪犯之一，他们的帝国变得更加强大。

sentences.en: With each bad president came new depths.
sentences.zh: 每一位糟糕的总统都带来了新的堕落。

sentences.en: America and the world would sink.
sentences.zh: 美国和世界将会沉沦。

sentences.en: And that they were in league with bankers and heads of state.
sentences.zh: 他们与银行家和国家元首勾结。

sentences.en: In this fringy alternate universe, senior Democrats run a secret child sex trafficking network.
sentences.zh: 在这个边缘的平行宇宙中，民主党高层经营着一个秘密的儿童性交易网络。

sentences.en: The deep state with child trafficking.
sentences.zh: 深层政府与儿童贩卖。

sentences.en: And that this goes back to the Rothschilds, who were a sort of financier family, typically associated with anti-Semitic conspiracy theories,
sentences.zh: 这可以追溯到罗斯柴尔德家族，这是一个通常与反犹太阴谋论联系在一起的金融家家族，

sentences.en: to the Seth Rich conspiracy theory about the death of a DNC staffer.
sentences.zh: 以及关于民主党全国委员会工作人员死亡的塞斯·里奇阴谋论。

sentences.en: In this alternate universe, the special counsel investigation is actually just a cover to
sentences.zh: 在这个平行宇宙中，特别检察官的调查实际上只是一个掩护，

sentences.en: really take down Hillary Clinton and Barack Obama because they were corrupted by the Kremlin.
sentences.zh: 目的是真正打倒希拉里·克林顿和巴拉克·奥巴马，因为他们被克里姆林宫腐蚀了。

sentences.en: Another conspiracy theory.
sentences.zh: 另一个阴谋论。

sentences.en: It's all there.
sentences.zh: 应有尽有。

sentences.en: It's sort of like a potpourri of internet derangement.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一锅互联网疯狂的大杂烩。

sentences.en: And this is all part of the theory that all of these powerful people are in league with a big and conspiratorial criminal enterprise.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都是该理论的一部分，即所有这些有权势的人都与一个庞大的、阴谋性的犯罪企业勾结在一起。

sentences.en: QAnon claims that a shadowy cabal within the U.S.
sentences.zh: QAnon声称美国政府内部的一个影子集团

sentences.en: government is at war with President Trump, and that the president will soon purge the country of these enemies.
sentences.zh: 正在与特朗普总统开战，总统很快就会清除国家的这些敌人。

sentences.en: In QAnon's telling, there is a group of sort of white hats who are people who are working on
sentences.zh: 在QAnon的叙述中，有一群所谓的“白帽”，他们是代表人民工作的人，

sentences.en: behalf of the people who are not part of this cabal, who convinced Donald Trump to run for president
sentences.zh: 他们不是这个集团的一部分，他们说服唐纳德·特朗普竞选总统，

sentences.en: so that he would be able to break up this cabal and expose the perpetrators and bring them to justice.
sentences.zh: 这样他就能瓦解这个集团，揭露肇事者，并将他们绳之以法。

sentences.en: And how does all of this end in Q's telling?
sentences.zh: 那么在Q的叙述中，这一切将如何结束？

sentences.en: Do you guys know what this represents?
sentences.zh: 你们知道这代表什么吗？

sentences.en: Tell us, sir.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我们，先生。

sentences.en: Maybe it's the calm before the storm.
sentences.zh: 也许这是暴风雨前的宁静。

sentences.en: In October of last year,
sentences.zh: 去年10月，

sentences.en: President Trump made a sort of offhanded reference to the calm before the storm.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统对“暴风雨前的宁静”做了一个随意的提及。

sentences.en: What storm, Mr. President?
sentences.zh: 什么暴风雨，总统先生？

sentences.en: You'll find out.
sentences.zh: 你会知道的。

sentences.en: Give us a hint.
sentences.zh: 给我们一点提示。

sentences.en: Thank you, everybody.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: This was seized on by Q.
sentences.zh: 这被Q抓住了。

sentences.en: And the storm, they think, is the sort of denouement of all of this.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，暴风雨是这一切的结局。

sentences.en: This is the culminating climactic event that will result in the exposure of all of these criminals and the ultimate victory of truth and righteousness.
sentences.zh: 这是一个最终的高潮事件，将导致所有这些罪犯的曝光，以及真理和正义的最终胜利。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Kevin, this sounds almost comically outlandish.
sentences.zh: 那么，凯文，这听起来简直荒谬得可笑。

sentences.en: It's hard to believe that it has many supporters.
sentences.zh: 很难相信它有这么多支持者。

sentences.en: Well, it didn't at firSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，起初并没有。

sentences.en: I mean, it was a pretty fringe community.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个相当边缘的群体。

sentences.en: It started to pick up steam on YouTube and Reddit and Facebook.
sentences.zh: 它开始在YouTube、Reddit和Facebook上获得动力。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Roseanne keeps promoting QAnon, the pro-Trump conspiracy theory that makes Pizzagate look tame.
sentences.zh: 罗珊娜不断宣传QAnon，这个让“披萨门”看起来都显得温和的亲特朗普阴谋论。

sentences.en: Some sort of fringe celebrities start tweeting about it and making references to it.
sentences.zh: 一些边缘名人开始在推特上谈论它并提及它。

sentences.en: So, Curt Schilling, the former baseball player, Roseanne Barr, became a believer in QAnon.
sentences.zh: 所以，前棒球运动员柯特·席林、罗珊娜·巴尔，都成了QAnon的信徒。

sentences.en: Barr's plugging of QAnon's theories drew renewed attention this Friday when she tweeted,
sentences.zh: 巴尔本周五在推特上发布消息，再次引起了人们对QAnon理论的关注，她说：

sentences.en: President Trump has freed so many children held in bondage to pimps all over the world.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统已经从世界各地的皮条客手中解救了许多被奴役的儿童。

sentences.en: It is a fairly large community of people who are invested in this narrative and looking for clues that what they believe is going to happen is actually going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当庞大的群体，他们投入了这个叙事，并寻找线索，证明他们相信会发生的事情确实会发生。

sentences.en: And Kevin, what exactly is the connection between this nascent movement and President Trump,
sentences.zh: 凯文，这个新兴运动与特朗普总统之间到底有什么联系，

sentences.en: beyond the fact that it seems to put him in a heroic place in its far-fetched narrative?
sentences.zh: 除了它似乎把他放在了其牵强叙事中的英雄位置之外？

sentences.en: To be clear, President Trump has never mentioned QAnon or any of the sort of various threads of this conspiracy theory.
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，特朗普总统从未提及QAnon或这个阴谋论的任何分支。

sentences.en: But QAnon believers who follow President Trump very closely are convinced that he is dropping hints to them, that there are things that he is saying that align with this
sentences.zh: 但非常密切关注特朗普总统的QAnon信徒确信，他正在给他们暗示，他所说的一些事情与这个

sentences.en: conspiracy theory and that ultimately this means that they are onto something.
sentences.zh: 阴谋论相吻合，最终这意味着他们发现了什么。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: So, one example would be the number 17.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，数字17。

sentences.en: You know, I told the story the other day.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我前几天讲过这个故事。

sentences.en: I was probably in Washington in my entire life
sentences.zh: 我这辈子可能在华盛顿待过

sentences.en: 17 times.
Q is the 17th letter of the alphabet.
sentences.zh: Q是字母表中的第17个字母。

sentences.en: And so QAnon believers have latched onto this as sort of their number of significance.
sentences.zh: 所以QAnon信徒把它当作他们重要的数字。

sentences.en: True.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: 17 times.
I don't think I ever stayed overnight.
sentences.zh: 我想我从来没有过夜。

sentences.en: You know what I'm getting at, huh?
sentences.zh: 你知道我在说什么，对吧？

sentences.en: And they've found several instances in which President Trump has said the number 17.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了特朗普总统提到数字17的几个例子。

sentences.en: Again, I've only been here about 17 times.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我只来过这里大约17次。

sentences.en: And probably seven of those times was to check out the hotel I'm building on Pennsylvania Avenue.
sentences.zh: 其中大约七次是为了看看我在宾夕法尼亚大道上建造的酒店。

sentences.en: And they view this as proof that they are communicating with President Trump that Q is a reliable source and that this whole conspiracy theory makes sense.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是证明他们正在与特朗普总统沟通、Q是一个可靠来源、以及整个阴谋论是有道理的证据。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a lot.
sentences.zh: 是的，内容很多。

sentences.en: So, why does this matter?
sentences.zh: 那么，这为什么重要？

sentences.en: This absolutely fantastical conspiracy theory that strains every ounce of credulity.
sentences.zh: 这个绝对奇幻的阴谋论挑战了每一分可信度。

sentences.en: Why are we talking about it?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么要谈论它？

sentences.en: It's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个好问题。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that there is a responsibility in the media not to amplify conspiracy theories.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为媒体有责任不去放大阴谋论。

sentences.en: I think for a long time, this was not worth talking about in mainstream circles.
sentences.zh: 我认为很长一段时间以来，这在主流圈子里是不值得谈论的。

sentences.en: But recently, it has started to move closer and closer to the mainstream.
sentences.zh: 但最近，它开始越来越接近主流。

sentences.en: There have been several instances where Q's followers have turned up in physical places.
sentences.zh: Q的追随者在现实中出现过几次。

sentences.en: Sunay authorities in Nevada say a man barricaded himself in an armored vehicle near the Hoover Dam
sentences.zh: 内华达州当局称，一名男子今天下午在胡佛大坝大桥附近的一辆装甲车内将自己封锁，

sentences.en: Bridge this afternoon, demanding President Trump release reports.
sentences.zh: 要求特朗普总统发布报告。

sentences.en: Troopers say he was armed with a rifle and stopped traffic for about 90 minutes.
sentences.zh: 警察说他带着步枪，并阻断了交通约90分钟。

sentences.en: So, just last month, a man armed with a gun drove an armored truck to the Hoover Dam and blocked traffic while talking about this conspiracy theory.
sentences.zh: 所以，就在上个月，一名持枪男子开着一辆装甲车来到胡佛大坝，在谈论这个阴谋论时阻断了交通。

sentences.en: They've turned up outside the office of Michael
sentences.zh: 他们出现在了迈克尔·阿文纳蒂（斯托米·丹尼尔斯的律师）的办公室外。

sentences.en: Avenatti, Stormy Daniels' lawyer.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，QAnon最初只是一个边缘的互联网阴谋。

sentences.en: And, I mean, QAnon started off as a fringe internet conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 但它在相当大的一群特朗普支持者中找到了市场，以至于他们现在带着Q的商品出现在集会上。

sentences.en: But it has found purchase with a fairly large group of Trump supporters to the point that they're now showing up at rallies with Q merchandise.
sentences.zh: 在你看来，这个群体的成员出现在佛罗里达州的这次集会上有什么意义？

sentences.en: And in your mind, what is the significance of people from this group appearing at this rally in Florida?
sentences.zh: 我认为它做了几件事。

sentences.en: I think it does a couple things.
sentences.zh: 第一，我认为他们相信这让运动更接近主流，教育了更多人，并将他们纳入其中。

sentences.en: One, I think they believe it sort of brings the movement closer to the mainstream and educates more people and brings them into the fold.
sentences.zh: 但这对于在家观看的人来说也是一种信号，表明他们并不孤单。

sentences.en: But it's also kind of a signal to the people watching back at home that they're not alone.
sentences.zh: 这不是一小群人，这是一个不断增长的网络，他们了解别人不了解的事情，他们分享这种秘密知识。

sentences.en: This isn't a tiny group of people, that this is a growing network of people who understand something that no one else understands, that they share this secret knowledge
sentences.zh: 这并不是一小群人，而是一个不断壮大的人群网络，他们了解别人所不知道的事情，他们共享着这种秘密知识。

sentences.en: with lots of other people, and that this is a source of power and legitimacy for them.
sentences.zh: 还有许多其他人，这对他们来说是力量和合法性的来源。

sentences.en: It also seems like it feeds the conspiracy by directly connecting the QAnon world to President
sentences.zh: 这也似乎通过直接将“匿名者Q”世界与总统联系起来，从而助长了阴谋论。

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: Yeah.
